result.note: A corporate launch with a slight payments angle. One question tests the launch bank and the exclusion of the domestic RuPay network.

questions.prompt: In October 2026, Apple Pay was launched in India. Consider the following statements about the launch:
items: It was launched through Axis Bank.
It supports RuPay credit cards alongside Visa and Mastercard credit cards.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Apple Pay was launched through Axis Bank, so statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong because the service covers Visa and Mastercard credit cards but leaves out the domestic RuPay network.
questions.source: Apple Pay launched in India through Axis Bank, covering Visa and Mastercard credit cards but excluding the domestic RuPay network.
